title: Levante Brewing Company: Phrequenty Phily IPA 9
summary: This collaboration was quite possibly THE worst beer I have tasted in a long time. Free and Cold used to be my favorite flavor but it is now Free and Cold except for this beer. It had soooo much coconut in it. Any coconut is too much (I didn't order a frozen cocktail) but this was over powering.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Category: drank-beer

This collaboration was quite possibly THE worst beer I have tasted in a long time. Free and Cold used to be my favorite flavor but it is now Free and Cold except for this beer.

 

It had soooo much coconut in it. Any coconut is too much (I didn't order a frozen cocktail) but this was over powering.
